mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park. Looking ahead, the overnight low will dip to 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.
In city news, the Verona Police Department released a summary of notable calls from October 5 through October 12, which included a mix of traffic accidents and one arrest on an outstanding warrant.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the fun continues with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market, and trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly police report, on October 9, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on USH 18/151 near mile marker 76, which resulted in a citation for unsafe lane deviation.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
